caption: The drawing features a single metallic bell suspended from a bracket with a handle. The bell is rendered in shades of yellowish-gold, with darker areas indicating shadows and texture, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. The supporting bracket and handle are depicted in dark brown and rusty tones, with some areas showing hints of blue-green oxidation, suggesting an aged metal surface. The bell has a clapper hanging inside, also colored in similar yellow-gold hues. The bracket curves upward and outward from where it attaches to the bell, with two circular holes near the bottom of the frame, which likely serve as mounting points. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color with no additional objects present. Near the bottom right, there is a small inscription in capital letters.
title: Dinner Bell
